payload.summary: The account msmith on host victim-web-01 experienced a brute-force attack from IP 10.77.0.64, with 10 failed login attempts followed by a successful login. The source IP is known to the account and has been used previously, but the pattern of failed attempts followed by a successful login is indicative of a brute-force attack.

attack_chain.description: The attacker used brute-force techniques to guess the password of the account msmith on host victim-web-01, as evidenced by 10 failed login attempts followed by a successful login from IP 10.77.0.64.

risk_factors: Successful login after multiple failures suggests attacker success

proposed_actions.justification: The account msmith experienced a brute-force attack, indicating potential compromise. Disabling the account will prevent further unauthorized access.
